title: Dartmouth Curling Club
gap: Duration for Adult Learn to Curl session not explicitly stated but inferred from times
blurb: Guests can rent ice sheets for curling, participate in adult learn to curl sessions, or register for curling events such as cashspiels. The club has been operating since 1936 and is located at 35 Canal Street, Dartmouth, Nova Scotia. It offers community curling activities and sponsorship opportunities.
